## Julia Slack

Use [`#bayes`](https://julialang.slack.com/archives/C0BKRUEN6CX) for general JuliaBayes chat and [`#bayes-dev`](https://julialang.slack.com/app_redirect?channel=bayes-dev) for development discussion.
[Join Julia Slack](https://julialang.org/slack/) if you need an account.

## GitHub

For questions or bug reports about a package, open an issue in its repository under [JuliaBayes](https://github.com/JuliaBayes).
For this website, [open an issue in the website repository](https://github.com/JuliaBayes/juliabayes.github.io/issues).
